newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks rebound to end higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks rebound to end higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks, after opening weak, rebounded towards Thursday's close on new accounts day buying and dealers said the index would gain further soon.

"Sentiment remained volatile today and the index dipped in the morning session," dealer Ambreen Shaukat said. "But it rebounded later. Bank stocks rose on fresh buying on hopes of higher profits, while telecom utility PTCL and Hub Power were also in demand."
The index rose 7.21 points, or 0.45 percent, to end at 1,625.36. Gainers beat losers 138 to 128. Schon Bank rose 1.50 rupees to 10.75. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
